name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza deaths 21–23 Nov; Yemen strikes 23 Nov
summary: Gaza health ministry reports deaths on 21–23 Nov; Houthi missile at Saudi Arabia 22 Nov; Saudi strike on Hodeida
state: Gaza's health ministry reported six Palestinians killed on 21 Nov, including three in a strike on a food-aid vehicle in Gaza City, with six more killed on 22 Nov and at least four on 23 Nov, among them an UNRWA employee (Democracy Now). On 22 Nov the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the western Red Sea coast, and Houthi media said a Saudi attack on Hodeida killed four people on 23 Nov (CBS News). Lebanon says Israeli attacks since March have killed more than 4,300 people (CBS News). Hostilities on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: People in or travelling to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen or Saudi Arabia should follow FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice. Regional airspace closures and flight disruption remain possible.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front escalation; deadly strikes in Gaza 21–23 Nov, Houthi–Saudi exchanges 22–23 Nov, Israeli strikes in Lebanon

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
